$comment: COMMITTED, on purpose (since 2026-09-03). Until then this file and hooks/ were git-ignored and claimed to be installed by a setup/ folder that never existed, so a fresh clone got no tailwind regen hook and nothing could recreate it. Machine-specific overrides belong in settings.local.json, which stays ignored. The deny list is a backstop under the rules in CLAUDE.md and the shared-checkout skill, not a replacement for them: a differently-ordered flag can slip past a glob. The patterns deliberately do NOT match `git push --force-with-lease`, which CLAUDE.md sanctions.
